title: Search Tools, Bash, Git Ops, SandboxBackend
description:
Implement remaining built-in tools and SandboxBackend from docs/plans/06-built-in-tools.md.

Sections: §4.5 (bash), §4.6 (grep - pure Go), §4.7 (glob), §4.8 (git commands), §5.2 (SandboxBackend), §3.2 (NewSandboxTools factory)

Key deliverables:
- grep: pure-Go regex/literal search with glob filters, bounded output
- glob: doublestar pattern matching, sorted, bounded output
- bash: shell command execution with timeout, streaming ToolProgress updates, resource hints
- git_status, git_diff, git_log, git_show (Tier 1 read-only)
- git_add, git_commit (Tier 2 mutating)
- SandboxBackend: RPC client adapter, streams progress via RPC, returns SnapshotID
- NewSandboxTools factory returning []agent.AgentTool
- Unit tests for all tools + component tests for SandboxBackend

Required reading: docs/plans/00-implementation-guide.md
See Implementation Guide §1.6 (ToolBackend), §4.6 (ToolBackend signature drift - SandboxBackend must accept onProgress), §5 (Seam: tools.SandboxBackend ↔ rpc.ExecuteToolStream)

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools.md §4.5-§5.2
- Test harness: docs/plans/06-built-in-tools-test-harness.md
- Depends on: T4 (Tool Framework + File Tools)
